linkedin:
AI now appears in 12% of active remote listings on our board — 487 of 3,928 jobs we analyzed on 2026-10-12 explicitly ask for AI skills.

It's not only engineering. We found AI requirements across senior software roles, people operations, sales, and even an insurance agent position. Companies listed include Jabil, Sardine, Sycle LLC, Creator, HSS Careers, Censys, and Devoted Studios.

The pay signal is mixed. The top disclosed range is USD 132,400–238,400 per year at Jabil. But only 22% of listings (844 of 3,919) disclose any salary, and 78% hide it entirely — so a big figure doesn't guarantee a premium.

Context helps: communication is still required in 41% of listings, well ahead of AI's 12%. Domain expertise and soft skills still matter most.

If you're building AI skills alongside a strong core discipline, here's what the data says about where they count, and how to show them in an application.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/ai-skills-in-demand-for-remote-jobs-2026
